findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/Coxeter/Matrix.lean:73 `diagonal i : M i i = 1`, line 85 `attribute [simp] diagonal`. The parallel file `Coxeter/Matrix.lean` correctly adds no such restatement for `coxeterMatrixOfBase`.
findings.fix: Delete the lemma; at its single use site (line 165, inside `coxeterMatrix_eq_of_isSimplyLaced`) write `t.coxeterMatrix.diagonal i` or let `simp` close it.
findings.issue: `coxeterMatrix_apply_self : t.coxeterMatrix i i = 1` is exactly Mathlib's `CoxeterMatrix.diagonal`, which is already a simp lemma (`attribute [simp] diagonal`, Mathlib/GroupTheory/Coxeter/Matrix.lean:85); its own proof is `t.coxeterMatrix.diagonal i`.

findings.fix: In `Coxeter/Matrix.lean` factor one construction, e.g. `def coxeterMatrixOfCartanMatrix (A : Matrix B B ℤ) (hdiag : ∀ i, A i i = 2) (hsymm : ∀ i j, A i j = 0 ↔ A j i = 0) (hmem : ∀ {i j}, i ≠ j → A i j * A j i ∈ ({0,1,2,3} : Set ℤ)) : CoxeterMatrix B`, with its `_apply` and `_eq_two_iff` lemmas, and define both `coxeterMatrixOfBase P b` and `t.coxeterMatrix` from it. All three hypotheses exist on both sides: `RootPairing.Base.cartanMatrix_apply_same` / `DynkinType.cartanMatrix_apply_same` (DynkinType.lean:244), `Base.cartanMatrix_apply_eq_zero_iff_symm` / `DynkinType.cartanMatrix_apply_eq_zero_iff_symm` (DynkinType.lean:288), and the two `cartanMatrix_mul_cartanMatrix_mem_of_ne`.
findings.issue: `DynkinType.coxeterMatrix` is a verbatim clone of `coxeterMatrixOfBase` (Coxeter/Matrix.lean:227-236): identical `M := .of fun i j ↦ coxeterOrder (A i j * A j i)`, identical `isSymm` proof (`ext i j; simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, mul_comm]`), identical `diagonal i := by simp`, identical `off_diagonal` via `two_le_coxeterOrder`. The derived lemmas clone too: `coxeterMatrix_apply` (129) vs `coxeterMatrixOfBase_apply` (Matrix.lean:243, down to the same `(rfl)` comment), and `coxeterMatrix_apply_eq_two_iff` (138) re-proves `cartanMatrix_mul_cartanMatrix_eq_zero_iff` (Matrix.lean:164-167) inline with the same `or_iff_left_iff_imp.mpr fun h ↦ ...cartanMatrix_apply_eq_zero_iff_symm.mpr h` term. `cartanMatrix_mul_cartanMatrix_mem_of_ne` even repeats the existing name in a second namespace.

summary: The per-type identifications are new material, but `DynkinType.coxeterMatrix` and its entry API are a verbatim clone of the existing `coxeterMatrixOfBase` construction in `Coxeter/Matrix.lean` (same fields, same proofs, same lemma set, one name even colliding), and `coxeterMatrix_apply_self` restates Mathlib's `CoxeterMatrix.diagonal`, which is already `@[simp]`.
